description:
Sun Peaks Corporation (SP) and the Kamloops Snowmobile Association (KSA) maintain signage to educate the public on staying on the designated trail when accessing Tod Mountain. This agreement has been in effect since 1995 through the LRUP process.

Snowmobilers are required to use the approved operating route, as identified on the RST website map.

Due to the expansion of Sun Peaks, snowmobile access to Tod Mountain is permitted ONLY via this approved route. Any travel off route is a contravention.Non-compliance may result in charges under the Trespass Act

This network is comprised of non-status and Forest Service Roads. If the road is plowed, that prohibits the use of snowmobiles, as per the Forest Road Use Regulation.

These trails are maintained under a Partnership Agreement with the Kamloops Snowmobile Association. Visit their webpage for membership details, day passes and trail conditions.

Visit Snowmobiling in BC for more information. Please obey all signs and respect the boundaries of the Sun Peaks ski hill operating area.
directions: Approximately a 45 minute drive from Kamloops. Access to the Tod Mountain Snowmobile trails is through the Sun Peaks ski area village. Once in the village follow the signage to the snowmobile parking area.
title: Tod Mountain Snowmobile Trails
